notes_for_review: Mostly a protocol paper: the diffusion/LLM part (Astra vs Qwen3-VL vs random/coordinate/CMA-ES search) is described as proposed, yet Tables 2-5 give precise result numbers for it without saying they were measured, which is odd and should not be cited as evidence. The executed experiments use a seeded numerical search (no LLM) to change three biases or readout coefficients in tiny fixed-random-feature networks on CBSD68. Their useful finding is negative: a reference-free proxy can improve while unseen-scene quality gets worse.
